transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Thanks for seeing me, I'm really relieved to be here. I've just been struggling so much because I start projects really excited, but I can't seem to follow through and finish my assignments or freelance client work on time unless there's an absolute crisis. It's getting really hard to manage on my own.

Have you had these problems with staying organized, finishing tasks, or getting distracted since childhood, like back in school, or did they only start more recently? Also, do they happen in more than one area of life, such as both work and home?

Yes, they've actually been there since childhood—my elementary school teachers always said I was "bright but daydreams," and I'd constantly forget my homework or fidget in class. It definitely affects both school and home now, from missing major deadlines and nearly failing a class to forgetting to pay my share of the utilities and my roommates telling me I never relax. It just became completely unmanageable over the last year and a half when my workload increased.

Do you spend most days feeling excessive, hard-to-control worry about several areas of life, even when you’re not trying to focus on a task? If so, did that worry start before these attention problems got worse?

I wouldn't say I have general, uncontrollable worry about everything in my life. Any anxiety or stress I do feel is pretty much always tied directly to me falling behind on schoolwork, missing deadlines, or messing up with clients. It's not a constant, unrelated worry that just happens on its own.

Besides trouble focusing and finishing tasks, do you also often make careless mistakes, lose things, forget appointments, or avoid tasks that take a lot of mental effort? Which of these happens most often for you?

I constantly make careless mistakes and forget daily tasks, though I don't really lose physical items. On my data science assignments, I'll lose tons of points because I missed something tiny like a minus sign or a column name right before submitting. I also frequently forget to do things like reply to professors, sign up for office hours, or pay my utility bills on time.
Do you also often feel physically restless or driven to keep moving, talk a lot, interrupt people, or act before thinking? Have these been present since childhood too?

Yes, I constantly feel a "buzzing" under my skin during long classes, and my roommates joke I don't know how to chill because I'm always pacing or starting new projects. I also frequently interrupt people and cut them off during group work, which is something my parents used to get called in for back in elementary school because I'd blurt out answers and fidget constantly.
